admin.loginHint: Enter the passcode for this device.
admin.emptyBoard: No orders yet. Enjoy the quiet.
admin.recentTruncated: Showing the last 10 of {{count}}. Earlier ones are still counted in Numbers.

settingsPanel.title: Event settings
settingsPanel.bannerHint: Shown at the top of the guest menu. Leave empty to hide.
settingsPanel.freeModeHint: Hides prices and records orders as free.
settingsPanel.autoAccept: Send new orders straight to Making
settingsPanel.limitsHint: Each guest is one browser. Clear cookies or use private mode and that device gets a fresh allowance, so these stop casual over-ordering rather than determined abuse.
settingsPanel.clearTodayHint: Deletes today's orders, puts their stock back, and restarts today's numbering at A-001. Earlier days stay untouched. This cannot be undone.
settingsPanel.clearConfirmBody_one: {{count}} order from today is deleted, its stock returned, and the next order starts again at A-001. This cannot be undone.
settingsPanel.clearConfirmBody_other: {{count}} orders from today are deleted, their stock returned, and the next order starts again at A-001. This cannot be undone.
settingsPanel.migrationMissing: This needs the 0002 SQL migration run in Supabase first.

modifiers.hint: Each group asks the guest to choose, like Milk or Sugar. Attach a group to a drink in the menu editor.
modifiers.empty: No groups yet. Add one for ice, sugar or milk.
modifiers.minZeroHint: Set the minimum to 0 to make the whole group optional.
modifiers.ingredientHint: Optional. Choosing this option then deducts stock, so oat milk can run out like anything else.
modifiers.deleteGroupConfirm_one: Delete {{name}}? It comes off {{count}} drink. Past orders keep the choice they were given.
modifiers.deleteGroupConfirm_other: Delete {{name}}? It comes off {{count}} drinks. Past orders keep the choice they were given.
modifiers.deleteOptionConfirm: Delete {{name}}? Past orders keep the choice they were given.

ingredients.hint: These are the stock levels the menu checks when a guest orders. Anything at or below its low level is flagged here.
ingredients.empty: No ingredients yet. Add coffee, milk or cups to start tracking them.
ingredients.name: Name
ingredients.packHint: Optional. Set a pack size to count this in boxes or bags, like 1000 ml for a one litre box of milk.
ingredients.addStockPacks: How many packs did you add?
ingredients.deleteConfirm: Delete {{name}}? Every drink recipe that uses it loses that line, and past orders keep their own copy.
ingredients.activeHint: Turn off for something you have stopped buying. Drinks that need it show as finished.

stats.hint: Only real orders are counted. Today means today in Brunei time.
stats.empty: No orders yet today. These numbers appear after the first one.
